notes.content:

[list]

[*]High [b]replayability value and endless continuing[/b] Build huge worlds and beautiful shelters!
[*]The ultimate blend of [b]creativity and survival[/b]!
[*]Many [b]accessibility options[/b] including key remapping (bottom of the Steam page more details).

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Sprinting, Stamina, Boiling water, Big Performance Update, FPS limit
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43241795/1bc8df0ccfaad0fb8460c84e7086e6cf383a06b5.png[/img]
[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]

First of all, we want to say a big thank you to all of you who played Above Snakes: Prologue! The game has been downloaded more than 400.000 times. This number is just insane to us and we can not be grateful enough!

We also received a lot of feedback from you and are happy to say that we worked on most of it. These updates will be included in this patch and also in the full game that comes out on May 25th.

We are happy to announce that we patched Above Snakes: Prologue and can already give you a sneak peek of the features and improvements that the full game will offer.

For those of you, who don't like to read patch notes, we summed up the most important points in a short devlog-style video here:

[previewyoutube=g2ebkW6TvSU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Instead of a textual introduction to the story, you will see an animated and fully voiced intro cinematic when starting a new journey.
[*]Sprinting & Stamina: You can now sprint for a short time (Shift key). Sprinting will consume stamina which regenerates over time. Dodge rolls (Space key) also consume stamina now. You can level your stamina with a skill to sprint for longer.
[*]Added Playstation 5 Dualsense Controller support.
[/list]

[h3]Changed Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed that axe and pickaxe are created from twigs and logs. You now need flints and hard antler (alongside other resources) to create your first tools  (so we did some changes to the Jo Ann quest line). This should give a more realistic feeling of survival.
[*]Lake water spots can not "dry out". Instead, they provide Dirty Water. Scooping water will increase fatigue. Dirty Water can be boiled to Clean Water at campfires.
[*] Campfires created by NPCs now provide warmth.
[*]Healthy Buff (all needs above 50%) regenerates health instead of providing additional movement speed.
[*]When removing the cottage, the sawmill and Jo Ann's house, you will receive some resources (as stated by Jo Ann).
[*]Destroying structures with the hammer returns (some) resources and not the whole item.
[*]You will always respawn at the last bed you slept in.
 [*]You can also sleep in Hunter's Rest in other beds now.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Inputs on Steam Deck automatically triggers Virtual Keyboard.
[*]You can now choose your button icons when using controllers (Xbox, PS, Nintendo).
[*]Added an inverted camera option.
[*]Changed 3d model of cartography table to look less like the Workbench.
[*]While looking at the map, you can still see how many world pieces are available.
[*]Workbench crafting menu is now integrated into the Backpack UI.
[*]When receiving a buff or debuff, a text is shown.
[*]New building item: Log Steps to make it easier to step on foundations.
[*]Added UI scaling and optimized screen resolution when running on Steam Deck.
[/list]

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overall big improvements to Memory and GPU consumption. Memory consumption is reduced by roughly 50%.
[*]We also added an FPS limiter that can limit the FPS to 30, 60, or 120.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]We generally fixed a lot of small bugs and the overall feeling of the game should feel better and more polished.
[*]Looted crates and barrels do not reset their loot when reloading the game.
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*]All translations have been reworked and should have improved significantly.
[*]Added support for Polish, Spanish (Latin America), Chinese (Traditional)
[/list]

[h2]Steam Deck Verified[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43241795/258719274368641715fffdc45b4860dee90dea7f.png[/img]
We are also happy to announce that Above Snakes: Prologue is Verified for Steam Deck!

Hope that you will enjoy this patch and are looking forward to the release of the full game as much as we do!

[h2]Wishlist to get notified on May 25th[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1589120/Above_Snakes/

notes.title: Full Game - Languages & Pricing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43241795/5c980ba1880ac09ce963766e8794a336924b651b.png[/img]
[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]

As you know, Above Snakes: Prologue is the free version of Above Snakes. [b]And it is not long now until Above Snakes releases on May 25th![/b] We hope you are as excited as we are! As promised, we will give you an overview regarding all of the supported languages, as well as regional pricing.

[h2]Localization of the Full Game[/h2]
The full game will be fully localized into the following languages:

[list]
[*]English
[*]Deutsch
[*]Español (España)
[*]Español (Latinoamérica)
[*]Français
[*]Português (Brasil) 
[*]Polski
[*]Русский
[*]简体中文
[*]繁體中文
[*]한국어
[/list]

We will consider adding more languages down the road based on demand for the game in certain regions.

[h2]Pricing of the Full Game[/h2]
Prices on Steam depend heavily on your location and currency. [b]We stick to Valve's pricing recommendations regarding regional prices which takes regional economic differences into account.[/b]

Please note that Valve updated their regional pricing in 2022, therefore you will find games released prior to that with vastly different regional pricing.

[list]
[*]$24.99 (US Dollars)
[*]24.99€ (Euro)
[*]£20.99 (British Pound)
[*]880 ₽ (Russian Ruble)
[*]R$ 73,99 (Brazilian Real)
[*]¥ 2800 (Japanese Yen)
[*]₩ 27000 (South Korean Won)
[*]₺235,00 (Turkish Lira)
[*]Mex$ 282.99 (Mexican Peso)
[*]CDN$ 32.50 (Canadian Dollar)
[*]A$ 36.50 (Australian Dollar)
[*]89,99zł (Polish Zloty)
[*]¥ 85 (Chinese Yuan)
[*]NT$ 408 (Taiwan Dollar)
[*]ARS$ 1750,00 (Argentine Peso)
[*]you can ask us for other currencies.
[/list]
[h1]We will also grant a 10% launch discount for the first week![/h1]

It is important to note that these prices may not be final and we reserve the right to make adjustments. In the event that there are any adjustments, we will communicate them to our community accordingly.

We can't wait to see you enjoy the game and craft your own beautiful worlds. Let us know in the comments if we are missing a localization for a language that you would like to see and we will check if it is possible to include.

Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Character Movement Speed, Water Sources and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Howdy adventurers!

We are happy to roll out version 1.0.2 of Above Snakes: Prologue and [b]fix many of the small bugs[/b] that have been reported and also do some[b] improvements to balancing and localization[/b]!

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased character movement speed (please let us know if it feels better).
[*] "Healthy" buff that is applied if all needs are above 50%, provides health regeneration.
[*] Lake water replenishes much faster now (we will completely change this mechanic in the full version).
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped you from progressing when eating a huckleberry from your inventory instead of from the hot bar during "Don't Starve!" quest.
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped you from progressing when you built a roof over Jo Ann's note.
[*] Mushroom soup recipe is now actually added to recipes if the recipe book is used.
[*] Fixed that death lead to the main menu (instead of loading the save game).
[*] Fixed that vanilla and honey now properly make a recipe when cooked.
[*] Fixed endless money glitch by selling robes.
[*] Fixed that cartography table sometimes was not interactable when placed too closed to a wall.
[*] Grass does not clip through foundations anymore.
[*] Fixed that character falling animation played near lakes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused items to duplicate in storage chests.
[*] If a workstation is not in range, the UI shows the text "Requires ..." in red.
[*] Inventory headers are now translated properly.
[*] Fixed that Aiyana's position and the workbench were invisible on the map at night.
[*] Changed the UI symbol that is shown for fishing spots if the player has no rod (also shown at some other occasions).
[*] Recipe Book can be trashed and sold.
[*] Syrup does not show "cookd meal" in recipe book.
[*] Flora Rivers hat matches her portait
[*] Inside the starting house you can not step on grass.
[/list]

[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Major improvements to Chinese localization (shout-out and thank you to community member Bill Wu).
[*] Some improvements to German localization.
[*] Minor improvements to all other localizations.
[/list]

We also want to thank everybody for playing Above Snakes: Prologue! We are truly overwhelmed with the feedback! Also, if you haven't already done that, we would appreciate an honest Steam review.

Cheers,
Tobi
